name: plugins-and-mods-by-xryul
description: Claude Code plugins and mods by xRyul: Dracula transcript styling, a Bash permission gate and a prompt timeline pane

plugins.name: dracula-theme-mod
plugins.description: Dracula transcript styling: tool call cards, coloured status lines, inline code pills and no dots

plugins.name: bash-permissions
plugins.description: Asks before dangerous Bash commands (git push, gt submit, pscale deploy, mysql, …), showing the whole command, a one-sentence explanation and a danger score. /bash-permissions shows the rules.

plugins.name: prompt-timeline
plugins.description: A pane listing this session's prompts with their age and context usage; click one to scroll the transcript to it, find to search every prompt's full text, or tree to see every branch a rewind left and continue from one. /timeline shows or hides it, and /resume-at opens a session at any of its messages.
